## Design

- [ ] I read `AGENTS.md`.
- [ ] Design is documented before implementation.
- [ ] Alternatives were compared in `docs/architecture/alternative-analysis.md`.
- [ ] An ADR was added or updated where required.
- [ ] Bounded contexts, invariants, and failure modes are documented.

## Correctness and security

- [ ] Tests were written first or existing executable specifications were updated.
- [ ] Negative, timeout, retry, cancellation, and degraded-dependency paths are covered.
- [ ] No secrets, private keys, PII, or sensitive tax evidence are included.
- [ ] Authorization, replay, arithmetic, serialization, and account-validation impact was reviewed.

## Performance and operations

- [ ] Latency/throughput/resource impact is measured or explicitly unchanged.
- [ ] Observability, alerts, runbooks, and rollback/migration behavior are updated.
- [ ] Docker-based reproducibility was checked.

## UI/UX

- [ ] No demo-only or fake-success behavior was added.
- [ ] Loading, error, stale, retry, and reconciliation states are implemented.
- [ ] Accessibility, keyboard navigation, responsive layout, localization, and clear financial explanations were reviewed.
